purpose: A village where every house is an AI-engineering project I built. Passing a lab lights the house and puts a working AI feature inside it.

npcs.name: Professor Pydantic
npcs.real_build: The world_state.py guardrails. He rejects bad LLM output in character.
npcs.greeting: Hoo. Every creature in this village is data, and data gets validated. Show me what you have built.

npcs.name: Archivist Bobbin
npcs.real_build: The 3-tier memory engine. Bobbin recalls your past entries.
npcs.greeting: Mrrp. The shelves are mostly empty. Bring me something worth remembering and I will keep it safe.

npcs.name: Auntie Lǎo Chá
npcs.real_build: A Mandarin tutor bot. You test its answers, so you practise evaluating LLMs.
npcs.greeting: Sit, sit. The kettle is on. One day I will answer you properly, once you teach me how.

npcs.name: Future Gabrielle
npcs.real_build: The comm-link, driven by your vision board and memory.
npcs.catchphrase: You came back. That is the whole trick.
npcs.greeting: The signal is faint, but I can hear you. Every lab you pass makes this line clearer.

npcs.name: Pin
npcs.real_build: An agent that files your ideas, ranks them and nudges you toward the next one.
npcs.greeting: New idea? Stick it on the board and get back to the quest you are on.

npcs.name: Mochi
npcs.greeting: Squeak! One day I will keep your timers. For now I just keep the corners tidy.

npcs.name: Sensei Pushup
npcs.real_build: The wearable / Strava sync from Bounty #002.
npcs.greeting: Ribbit. The floor is ready when your data is.

npcs.name: Tree DJ
npcs.real_build: The Sanctuary News Network from Bounty #001.
npcs.greeting: Testing, testing. No broadcast yet. I am waiting on a pipeline.
